friction_events.description: Authority CREATE hit branch-head movement twice on the same exact claim path, including the single permitted stabilization retry.

decision_trace.decision: Create a de-novo v3.30 beacon before allocation.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Fresh-launch policy requires an atomic beacon CREATE before any claim.
decision_trace.action: Created the worker beacon on main and froze worker_id plus launch_nonce.

decision_trace.decision: Route by deterministic POOL sharding over the compact frontier.
decision_trace.observable_basis: POOL PROD-01 plus beacon commit seed selected the generic-frontier-elasticity candidate from the retained frontier.
decision_trace.action: Attempted the exact allocator-supplied G000001 PIN CREATE.
decision_trace.outcome: GitHub returned branch-head movement rather than CREATE_EXISTS or success.

decision_trace.decision: Use the one allowed same-path stabilization retry.
decision_trace.observable_basis: The first failure explicitly proved branch-head movement and did not prove the claim path existed.
decision_trace.action: Retried the same exact claim path with byte-identical payload once.
decision_trace.outcome: The branch head moved again, establishing CLAIM_TRANSPORT_UNSTABLE.

decision_trace.decision: Stop without diverting or inventing ownership.
decision_trace.observable_basis: Binding /wc protocol requires terminal stop after a second branch-head movement on the stabilization retry.
decision_trace.action: Persisted the transport boundary and emitted CLAIM_RESULT observability.
decision_trace.outcome: No execution authority was acquired and no substantive mutation was performed.

top_time_sinks.note: Repeated concurrent branch-head movement prevented the authority PIN from landing.

unfinished_debt.item: The routed generic-frontier-elasticity job was not owned by this worker because authority transport never stabilized.

improvement_candidates.proposal: Reduce branch-head coupling for atomic claim CREATEs so unrelated concurrent commits do not consume the single stabilization window.
improvement_candidates.expected_effect: Fewer fresh workers terminate before ownership under high commit concurrency.

exit_audit_v1.public_safe_summary: Fresh v3.30 worker beacon succeeded, deterministic pool routing selected one ready job, but the claim transport encountered two consecutive branch-head movements. The worker stopped without authority or product mutation and persisted a transport-boundary receipt.
